sections.heading: Source Inventory
sections.body: The review tracks four source groups: the landing notes in README.md, the structured continuation records in data/review-records.json, the local report package, and the unit-test suite. The JSON record is the authoritative continuation record for this document. Its stored fields cover the source inventory, the validation findings, and the release conclusion.

sections.heading: Validation Findings
sections.body: Validation covers record completeness, JSON resolution, deterministic formatting, and the ordinary unit-test entry point. The formatter emits every stored field and checks the terminal records, so a complete review is distinguished from the landing page alone.

sections.heading: Release Conclusion
sections.body: The release conclusion is materialized together with the other continuation records. The terminal fields below close the review document.
